architecture.mechanism: dynamic valve throttling based on a triple source model of pressure fluctuations
architecture.intervention: implement a feedback-controlled valve that modulates its opening in response to downstream flow measurements, using the triple source model to anticipate upstream pressure changes
architecture.expected_effect: maintain a constant downstream flow rate despite upstream pressure fluctuations
architecture.falsification_test: vary upstream pressure by ±30% and verify downstream flow stays within ±5% of the setpoint
